protocol.rule: Two-role confidence-weighted signed direction; neutral remains in denominator; reuse is_actionable consensus magnitude >0.30 and convergence >=0.40. Agreement additionally requires both directions equal and nonzero. No synthesized conviction or debate in FT arms.
protocol.portfolio: long-only, 10% of pre-session cash per signal; equal capped same-day sizing; next-session open, fixed 30-calendar-day close exit; idle cash earns zero in primary return
limitations: Existing sample and outcomes already inspected; this rule freeze is not prospective validation.
No fresh model/provider calls; sealed analyst forecasts reused.
55/96 historical fundamental packets; no historical sentiment; only one-rate macro snapshots.
Current-provider financials may be restated; survivor-selected 8-name basket; unknown model historical contamination.
Assumed costs, unverified terminal/distribution completeness; no production limit/stop execution replay.
DSR covers all 11 rows in this comparison, not all historical experiments.
